answer: Latency Profile Anchoring. Each identity must keep its inter-message timing signature inside a personal lag window set from its first epoch; agents whose entropy or response latency drifts past a fixed ledge are throttled and re-qualified. Because a sybil cluster needs each puppet to hold that same narrow profile across epochs, the attacker pays continuous compute to simulate distinct stable latencies—an anchor no mass-produced bot can fake cheaply. Honest actors drift freely within a wide lagoon of tolerance.
